caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a small elephant figurine placed in the center of a plain, off-white background. The elephant is viewed from the side, facing left, and appears to be made of a dark brown or bronze-like material with textured, mottled patterns on its surface. The figurine has detailed features, including defined ears, eyes, trunk, and legs, with some lighter and darker brown areas indicating shading and surface texture. There are two prominent yellowish patches, one on the elephant's ear and another on its body behind the front leg. The feet of the elephant are lighter in color, appearing almost beige or grayish. The image contains no additional objects or background scenery, and the artist's signature, "BEN LASSEN," is visible in faint letters in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Penny Bank (Elephant)
